description: This file defines the TbFlot class, a component responsible for rendering and managing interactive flot-based charts (line, bar, pie, state) within the Thingsboard platform. It handles data subscriptions, chart configuration, rendering, user interactions, tooltips, thresholds, and animations.

classes.name: TbFlot
classes.description: Main class managing flot chart rendering, data subscription, user interactions, and animations within the widget context.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the TbFlot instance, sets up chart options, and optionally creates the chart if a default subscription exists.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the chart with a DOM element and data subscription, configuring axes, series, thresholds, and rendering.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the chart with new data, handling axis visibility, thresholds, and animations.

methods.name: latestDataUpdate
methods.description: Refreshes the latest data and thresholds, updating the chart display.

methods.name: updateSeriesColor
methods.description: Changes the color of the first data series.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Handles resizing of the chart, adjusting radius for pie charts and redrawing.

methods.name: checkMouseEvents
methods.description: Enables or disables mouse interaction events based on edit mode.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources, subscriptions, and DOM elements when the chart is destroyed.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Clears timeouts and completes subjects for cleanup.

methods.name: createPlot
methods.description: Creates the flot plot instance with current data and options.

methods.name: updateData
methods.description: Sets new data to the plot and redraws.

methods.name: updateYMinMax
methods.description: Updates observable subjects with current Y-axis min/max values.

methods.name: redrawPlot
methods.description: Destroys and recreates the plot to apply configuration changes.

methods.name: createYAxis
methods.description: Creates a Y-axis configuration based on series settings.

methods.name: subscribeForThresholdsAttributes
methods.description: Subscribes to threshold data sources to update chart thresholds dynamically.

methods.name: thresholdsSourcesDataUpdated
methods.description: Processes threshold data to generate threshold markings.

methods.name: parseThresholdData
methods.description: Parses threshold data values from JSON or raw input.

methods.name: processSingleDataValue
methods.description: Creates a threshold marking for a single data value.

methods.name: generateThreshold
methods.description: Generates a threshold marking object.

methods.name: subscribeForLabelPatternsSources
methods.description: Subscribes to label pattern data sources for dynamic label updates.

methods.name: labelPatternsParamsDataUpdated
methods.description: Updates label patterns based on data source updates.

methods.name: substituteLabelPatterns
methods.description: Replaces variables in label patterns with actual data values.

methods.name: seriesInfoDiv
methods.description: Creates a DOM element displaying series info for tooltips.

methods.name: seriesInfoDivFromInfo
methods.description: Creates series info DOM element from hover info.

methods.name: createTooltipElement
methods.description: Creates the HTML element used for displaying tooltips.

methods.name: formatPieTooltip
methods.description: Formats tooltip content for pie slices.

methods.name: formatChartTooltip
methods.description: Formats tooltip content for chart data points.

methods.name: formatYAxisTicks
methods.description: Formats Y-axis tick labels.

methods.name: enableMouseEvents
methods.description: Enables mouse interaction events on the chart DOM element.

methods.name: disableMouseEvents
methods.description: Disables mouse interaction events.

methods.name: onFlotHover
methods.description: Handles hover events to show tooltips and highlight series.

methods.name: onFlotSelect
methods.description: Handles selection events to update the time window.

methods.name: onFlotDblClick
methods.description: Resets the time window on double click.

methods.name: onFlotMouseDown
methods.description: Marks that mouse interaction has started.

methods.name: onFlotMouseUp
methods.description: Marks that mouse interaction has ended.

methods.name: onFlotMouseLeave
methods.description: Hides tooltip and unhighlights series on mouse leave.

methods.name: onFlotClick
methods.description: Handles click events on chart slices.

methods.name: getHoverInfo
methods.description: Calculates hover information for data points.

methods.name: findHoverIndexFromData
methods.description: Finds the index of the data point closest to a given X position.

methods.name: findHoverIndexFromDataPoints
methods.description: Finds hover index from datapoints array.

methods.name: pieDataRendered
methods.description: Updates pie chart data for animation.

methods.name: nextPieDataAnimation
methods.description: Starts or continues pie chart data animation.

methods.name: onPieDataAnimation
methods.description: Performs animation step for pie chart.

methods.name: finishPieDataAnimation
methods.description: Completes pie chart animation.

methods.name: onPieSliceClick
methods.description: Handles click on a pie slice to trigger actions.
